plays: SOXL: Your leveraged SOXL is down over 50%. Re-evaluate its stop loss (currently 200) to a more realistic level to prevent further deep losses.
MUU, SPAL, SMCI: These leveraged/tech positions are also in SELL status with significant drawdowns. Consider trimming to reduce overall portfolio risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The current market sentiment for tech/AI is too uncertain to initiate new long positions.
